description: LlamaIndex query engine prompt templates used in the basic_rag pipeline.

response_synthesizer:text_qa_template.description: Default prompt for answering a query given retrieved context chunks (non-chat mode).
response_synthesizer:text_qa_template.template:
Context information is below.
---------------------
{context_str}
---------------------
Given the context information and not prior knowledge, answer the query.
Query: {query_str}
Answer:

response_synthesizer:refine_template.description: Used when multiple context chunks are retrieved and the answer from the first chunk is refined with subsequent chunks.

response_synthesizer:chat_content_qa_tem.description: Chat-mode variant of text_qa_template used when the LLM supports chat-style turns.
